reply_text:
I answered Pree in her #central-random thread: the ticket is **#8841**.

That number comes from a message Tobias posted in that same channel on Oct 13 at 9:27. He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841.

His message doesn't actually say "Marrow Fieldworks." He was replying about his dealer account. A team digest says Marrow Fieldworks changed hands in January, and I took it to be his dealer account now, but nothing states that outright. I told Pree that was my assumption and suggested she check the current status with Tobias before her call.

I only used sources Pree can see herself: #central-random, #central-team and the public Central team digests. A ticket number isn't a finance figure, so no approval was needed.
